name: ∞Bench
description: ∞Bench is the first benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to process and reason over extremely long contexts exceeding 100K tokens. It includes synthetic and realistic tasks in English and Chinese that require understanding long dependencies beyond simple passage retrieval.
reputation: A very recent long-context benchmark that has attracted attention in the long-context LLM community, but it is still early in adoption and not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Focuses on contexts longer than 100K tokens; tasks require understanding long dependencies; includes English and Chinese data.
